turns.question: It's the end of 5 October 2026 and our fiscal year starts on 1 February. What has our average daily revenue been so far this fiscal quarter, counting days with no orders as zero and leaving cancelled orders out?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average daily revenue metric, so I can't give that average; the closest, Revenue (EUR), totals 19573.59 EUR for 1 August to 5 October 2026 (fiscal Q3 to date, cancelled orders left out). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
